How do I change the delivery address on:
If the order hasn’t shipped, open **Your Orders**, select the order, and choose **Change delivery address** or **Edit order details**.

If that option isn’t available, contact the seller through the order page. You may need to cancel the order and place it again with the correct address. Avoid sending sensitive address details outside Tradepost’s messaging system.

Go to **Orders**, select the order, and choose **Change delivery address** if that option appears.

If it isn’t available, contact the seller or Tradepost Support immediately. You may need to cancel the order and place it again with the correct address. Don’t send a new address only through messages unless the order itself is officially updated.
Can I pay with a gift card?: Yes, Tradepost gift cards can generally be used at checkout. Enter the gift card code in the payment section; if the balance doesn’t cover the full order, you may be able to pay the remainder with another accepted method. Availability and restrictions may vary by item or region.

Tradepost gift-card acceptance can vary by checkout and region. At checkout, check the available payment methods for a **Gift card** option. If it isn’t listed, the gift card can’t be used for that purchase.
What does 'dispatched' mean on my order: “Dispatched” means the seller has sent your order and it’s on its way to you. Tracking may take a little while to update after dispatch.
“Dispatched” means the seller has sent your order and it’s on its way to you. Tracking details may appear on the order page once the carrier updates them.
How long do refunds take to reach my car: Refunds to a card typically arrive within **3–10 business days** after they’re issued, depending on your bank or card provider. If it’s been longer than 10 business days, contact your card provider for an update.

Refunds to a credit or debit card typically appear within **3–10 business days** after they’re issued, depending on your bank or card provider. If it’s been longer than 10 business days, contact your bank for an update.
Can I combine two orders from the same s: Orders can’t usually be combined after checkout. Before purchasing, ask the seller to create a single custom listing or combined invoice so you can pay once and potentially save on shipping. If you’ve already ordered, contact the seller promptly—they may be able to ship both together and refund any excess postage, at their discretion.

You can ask the seller to combine shipping before either order is dispatched. However, two completed orders generally can’t be merged into one order; the seller may still ship them together and potentially refund any excess shipping charge. Contact the seller promptly to confirm.
Where do I find my invoice?: Go to **My Tradepost → Orders**, select the relevant order, then choose **View invoice** or **Download invoice**. If you don’t see that option, check the order confirmation email or contact the seller for an invoice.
Go to **My Tradepost → Orders/Purchases**, open the relevant order, then select **View invoice** or **Download invoice**. It may also be attached to your order-confirmation email.
How do I leave a review?:
To leave a review on Tradepost:

1. Go to **Your Purchases/Orders**.
2. Select the completed order.
3. Choose **Leave a review**.
4. Add your rating and comments, then submit.

The review option may only appear after the order is completed.

To leave a review on Tradepost:

1. Go to **Your Orders** or **Purchase History**.
2. Select the completed order.
3. Choose **Leave a Review** or **Rate Purchase**.
4. Add your rating and comments, then submit.

The review option may only appear after the order is completed.
Can I cancel an order before it ships?: Yes—if the order hasn’t shipped, you can usually request cancellation from the order details page. Cancellation isn’t guaranteed if the seller has already begun processing it. If it has shipped, you may need to wait for delivery and request a return instead.

Yes—orders can usually be canceled before they ship. Go to **Your Orders**, select the order, and choose **Cancel order**. If that option isn’t available, contact the seller promptly; cancellation may no longer be possible if processing has begun.
Do you deliver to the Isle of Wight?: Delivery availability depends on the individual seller and courier. Enter your Isle of Wight postcode on the listing or at checkout to confirm whether delivery is available and whether any extra charges apply.
Delivery availability depends on the individual seller and courier. Enter your Isle of Wight postcode on the item’s checkout page to confirm whether delivery is available and view any extra charges.
How do I report a missing item?:
To report a missing item on Tradepost:

1. Go to **Purchases/Orders** in your account.
2. Select the relevant order.
3. Choose **Report a problem** or **Item not received**.
4. Follow the prompts and submit the report.

If only part of the order is missing, specify which item and include any photos of the package or packing slip. If you don’t see the reporting option, contact Tradepost Support with the order number.

To report a missing item on Tradepost:

1. Go to **Your Orders/Purchases**.
2. Select the affected order.
3. Choose **Report a problem** or **Get help with order**.
4. Select **Item missing** and follow the prompts.

If only part of the order is missing, specify which item and include photos of the package and shipping label if possible. Contact the seller first if the option appears; if it isn’t resolved, you can escalate through the order page.
Is there a fee for returns?: Return fees can vary by seller and by the reason for the return. Check the item’s return policy or your order details for any return-shipping or restocking fees. If the item is defective, damaged, or not as described, return costs are typically covered.
Return fees depend on the seller’s return policy and the reason for the return. Check the item’s return details or your order page to see whether return shipping or restocking fees apply.
How do I update my phone number?:
To update your phone number:

1. Sign in to your Tradepost account.
2. Go to **Account Settings** or **Profile**.
3. Select **Personal Information** or **Contact Details**.
4. Choose **Edit** next to your phone number.
5. Enter the new number and complete any verification steps.
6. Select **Save**.

If you can’t access your old number or sign in, use the **Account Recovery** option on the login page or contact Tradepost Support.

To update your phone number:

1. Sign in to your Tradepost account.
2. Go to **Settings** or **Account Settings**.
3. Select **Personal Information** or **Contact Details**.
4. Choose **Edit** next to your phone number.
5. Enter the new number and complete any verification steps.
6. Save your changes.

If you can’t access your old number for verification, use the account recovery or **Contact Support** option.
How do I change my username?: To change your username, go to **Settings → Account/Profile → Username**, enter your new username, and save your changes. If there’s no username option, contact Hearth support—username changes may require staff assistance or may be limited.

Go to **Settings → Account/Profile → Username**, enter your new username, and save your changes. If there’s no username option, contact Hearth support—username changes may be restricted or require staff assistance.
Can I hide my online status?: Yes. Go to **Settings → Privacy → Online Status**, then turn off **Show when I’m online**. Note that you may also stop seeing other members’ online status.
Yes. Go to **Settings → Privacy → Online Status**, then turn off **Show when I’m online**. Note that hiding your status may also prevent you from seeing others’ online status.
How do I start a new thread?: Go to the forum section where you want to post, then select **New Thread** or **Create Post**. Add a title and message, choose any relevant tags or category, and select **Post**. You may need to sign in first.

Go to the forum section where you want to post, then select **New Thread** or **Create Post**. Add a title and message, choose any required tags or category, and select **Post**. You may need to sign in first.
Why can't I upload a picture?:
Picture uploads can fail for a few common reasons:

- The file is too large or in an unsupported format—try JPG or PNG and reduce its size.
- Your browser/app lacks photo or storage permission.
- Your connection is unstable.
- The app or browser needs updating or refreshing.
- Uploads may not be enabled in that section of the forum.

Try refreshing, signing out and back in, or using another browser/device. If it still fails, tell me what device/browser you’re using and any error message you see.

Picture uploads can fail for a few common reasons:

- The file is too large or in an unsupported format—try JPG or PNG and reduce its size.
- Your browser or app lacks photo-access permission.
- Your connection is unstable.
- The app/browser needs an update or refresh.
- Uploads may be temporarily unavailable on Hearth.

Try refreshing, signing out and back in, or using another browser/device. If it still fails, tell me what device/browser you’re using and the exact error message you see.
How do I turn off email notifications?: Go to **Settings → Notifications → Email notifications**, then turn off the emails you no longer want. You can also use the **Unsubscribe** link at the bottom of any notification email.
Go to **Settings → Notifications → Email notifications**, then turn off the emails you no longer want. You can also use the **Unsubscribe** link at the bottom of any notification email.
What are badges for?: Badges are profile markers that recognize things like participation, achievements, roles, or special contributions in the Hearth community. They can help other members quickly understand your experience or involvement.
Badges are profile markers that recognize things like participation, achievements, milestones, or special community roles. They’re a quick way to show your contributions and status on Hearth.
Can I edit a post after 24 hours?: Yes—posts can still be edited after 24 hours, provided the discussion hasn’t been locked or archived. Look for the **Edit** option in the post menu.
Generally, posts can’t be edited after 24 hours. If you need to correct something important, contact a moderator for help.
How do I bookmark a thread?: Open the thread and select the **Bookmark** icon near the top of the page. If you don’t see it, check the **•••** menu and choose **Bookmark**. You can usually find saved threads under your profile’s **Bookmarks** section.
Open the thread and select the **Bookmark** icon (usually a ribbon or flag) near the post or thread controls. You can typically find saved threads later under **Profile → Bookmarks**.
How do I block direct messages?:
To block direct messages:

1. Open **Settings**.
2. Go to **Privacy** or **Messages**.
3. Find **Who can send you direct messages**.
4. Select **No one**, or limit messages to people you follow.

To block a specific member, open their profile or message, select the **•••** menu, and choose **Block**.

Where are the community rules?: You can find Hearth’s community rules in the **Community Guidelines** link, usually located in the forum’s main menu or page footer. If you don’t see it, check the **Help** or **About** section.

Can I delete my account?: Yes. You can delete your account from your account settings, usually under **Settings → Account → Delete account**. Be aware that deletion may be permanent, so download any data you want to keep first.

Yes. You can delete your account from your account settings. Look for **Settings → Account → Delete account** and follow the confirmation prompts. How do I quote another post?: Click **Quote** beneath the post you want to reference. Its text will appear in your reply editor; add your response below it, then click **Post**. You can also highlight part of a post first to quote only that section.

To quote another post, click or tap **Quote** beneath it. If you only want to quote part of the post, highlight that text first, then select **Quote**. The quoted text will appear in your reply editor.
How do I add a stop to my ride?:
To add a stop:

1. Open the Kerbside app and enter your destination.
2. Tap the **“+”** next to the destination field.
3. Enter the additional stop.
4. Drag the stops to reorder them if needed, then confirm your ride.

For an active ride, tap the trip details and look for **Add a stop**. Your fare and arrival time may update.

1. Open your ride in the Kerbside app.
2. Tap the destination field or **Edit trip**.
3. Tap **Add stop** or the **+** icon.
4. Enter the stop address, then confirm.

You can usually add a stop before requesting the ride or during the trip. Adding one may change the fare and arrival time.
Can I book a ride for someone else?: Yes. Enter the other person’s pickup and destination, then select the option to book for someone else and add their contact details. They’ll receive the driver and trip information. Make sure they can contact the driver and are ready at the pickup point.

Yes. Enter the other person’s pickup location and destination when booking, then select the option indicating the ride is for someone else. Add their name and phone number so the driver can contact them. The rider should confirm the driver and vehicle details before getting in.
How do I change my payment card?:
In the Kerbside app:

1. Open **Account** or **Profile**.
2. Tap **Payment** or **Wallet**.
3. Select **Add payment method** and enter your new card.
4. Set it as your **default** card.
5. Remove the old card if you no longer want it saved.

If a ride is already completed, changing your default card may not change the payment method used for that trip.

3. Select **Add payment method** to enter your new card.

What is the cancellation fee?: Cancellation fees vary by location and ride type. If a fee applies, you’ll see the amount in the app before confirming your cancellation. It may apply if you cancel after the grace period or after the driver has already made significant progress toward pickup.

Cancellation fees vary by location and ride type. The exact fee and any applicable grace period are shown in the app before you confirm cancellation. You generally won’t be charged if you cancel shortly after booking or if the driver is significantly delayed.
Can I bring a bike?: Yes, if the driver agrees and the bike fits safely in the vehicle. Consider booking a larger vehicle, and message the driver after booking to confirm. Bikes can’t block doors, seats, or safety equipment.

Yes, if the driver agrees and the bike fits safely in the vehicle. For the best chance, request a larger vehicle and message the driver immediately after matching. A folding bike is usually easier; otherwise, consider a bike-friendly ride option if available in your area.
How do I get a receipt?:

1. Open **Trips** or **Ride History**.
2. Select the ride.
3. Tap **Receipt**, then choose **Email** or **Download**.

Can I choose a quiet ride?: Yes—if “Quiet Ride” appears in your ride preferences or booking options, select it before confirming. Yes—if the ride option is available in your area, select **“Quiet Ride”** or a similar conversation-preference setting when booking. It signals that you’d prefer minimal conversation, though necessary safety or trip-related communication may still occur.
How do I add a work profile?:
To add a work profile in the Kerbside app:

1. Open the app and go to **Account**.

3. Tap **Add a work profile**.
4. Enter your work email and any requested company details.
5. Choose your preferred payment method and tap **Save**.

Do you have wheelchair-accessible cars?: Wheelchair-accessible vehicle availability varies by location. Check the Kerbside app’s ride options for a wheelchair-accessible or WAV option; if it isn’t shown, it may not currently be available in your area.

How do I share my trip status?:

1. Open the Kerbside app and view your active trip.
2. Tap **Share trip status** or **Share trip**.

4. Send the link so they can follow your trip details and live location.
